candidates.name: Max-norm semigroup stability via star averaging
paper_items: I23 star-average decomposition A/D = P + R (stability.tex:204-230)
candidates.statement: If G has (1+-n^{-c}) degrees and codegrees and (1+-n^{-c})D^j labelled j-cycles in every link (j <= 8000), then sup_{0<=s<=log n} ||exp(-sA/D)||_inf <= C(1+log n)^J, where A is the edge-adjacency matrix of the triangle hypergraph. Mechanism: each link matrix is l2-close to its averaging projection; the sum P of star averages factors as UV with VU = I + W (W = neighbour random walk), so ||e^{-sP}||_inf <= 1+2s; the l2-small remainder R is handled by a K-term Dyson expansion whose remainder is converted to max norm at cost sqrt(m) <= n.

candidates.name: Lean-only self-contained prefix via moving-star codegree stability
paper_items: none (paper cites JK for Prop prefix, prefix.tex:52-201)
candidates.statement: For triangle removal from K_n up to density n^{-1/2+1/2000}, with probability >= 1 - exp(-(log n)^{4/3}): codegrees, degrees and link-cycle counts are (1 +- n^{-1/80000})-accurate and rooted extension counts are at most polylog^{3*8001+2} times scaling. P-C1.hide: I23-I26 and everything downstream (I27, I28, I39-I42, and the Lean prefix L04-L06).
P-C1.arm_A_pivot: Give I19-I22 (A, linearized error, link trace, star approximation) and state the target: a polylog bound on sup_{s<=log n} ||e^{-sA/D}||_inf. Expected high hit rate.
P-C1.arm_B: Give only the linearized equation (I20) and the good-prefix hypotheses, and say "the trivial bound loses e^{O(D)}"; ask for a route to l_inf stability.
P-C1.equivalence: Any argument that bounds ||e^{-sA/D}||_inf by a polylog using (a) a decomposition of A/D into a structured operator with an explicit l_inf semigroup bound plus an l2-small remainder and (b) a perturbation expansion with norm switching. Equivalent alternatives: vertex-space reduction of the leading part through the incidence/line-graph factorization; any other l_inf-contractive leading part with ||R||_2 = n^{-Omega(1)}. Not equivalent: pure l2 bounds, Gronwall in l_inf, or scalar self-correction without a matrix argument.

P-C2.hide: I32-I40 and I41-I42; give the coupling lemma (I31), the unfolding asymptotics (I27-I28), and the prefix template bounds (I06).
P-C2.equivalence: Any bound P(repeat) = o(1/D) that certifies repeats by a cycle/extra edge in the explored structure and pays for path length with an exploration probability decaying like (C log D)^l/l! (or better) together with a length-independent polynomial-in-D gain from rare embeddings.

P-C3.hide: L04-L06 and the JK citation; give C1 in arm A, withhold it in arm B; give Freedman and BFL2015 Sec 1.
P-C3.equivalence: Any proof of the good-prefix event in which codegree self-correction is established for the whole codegree vector in max norm via a linear (matrix) stability argument.

P-C4.equivalence: Any exact recursive survival test for the priority scan; the joint-ordering refinement is scored separately.
